quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #12
										  					
  

37 Questions • Passing Score 32

questions.question: What does an "End school zone" sign mean?

options.text: A reduced speed zone is starting.
You may see more pedestrians ahead.
A reduced speed zone is ending.

questions.correctAnswerText: A reduced speed zone is ending.
questions.explanation: The "End school zone" sign marks where a reduced speed zone ends. Follow the school zone speed limit only during the times posted on the sign.

questions.question: At a light rail intersection, you should always:

options.text: Look both ways before crossing the tracks.
Pay attention and obey all traffic signals.
Share the road with pedestrians and bicyclists.

questions.explanation: Never drive around lowered crossing gates. Always look both ways before turning across train tracks. Always obey all signs and traffic signals. Trains share the road with cars, bicycles, and pedestrians.

questions.question: What does a red circle with a line through it mean on a regulatory sign?

options.text: Some drivers must yield to other drivers.
Drive slower than the speed limit.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs that forbid actions are white and rectangular with red and black markings. A red circle with a slash through a symbol means that action is forbidden.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A lane is ending or the road is narrowing ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A lane is ending or the road is narrowing ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn you about hazards ahead. This sign warns that a lane is ending or the road will narrow.

questions.question: What is true about drowsy drivers?

options.text: Strong black coffee will keep them awake.
They may drive as poorly as a drunk driver.
Opening a window and turning up the radio is enough to stay alert.
They are usually only older drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: They may drive as poorly as a drunk driver.
questions.explanation: Drowsy drivers can drive so poorly they appear drunk. Opening a window, turning on the radio, or drinking coffee is not enough to make a drowsy driver alert to road hazards.

questions.question: When you see a steady green arrow on a traffic signal, you:

options.text: Should move into a lane in the direction of the arrow.
Should slow down and stop if it is safe.
May turn in the direction of the arrow after letting traffic and pedestrians already in the intersection go first.
May drive straight through the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: May turn in the direction of the arrow after letting traffic and pedestrians already in the intersection go first.
questions.explanation: A green arrow means you may turn in that direction. You must be in the correct lane for the turn. Always let vehicles and pedestrians already in the intersection go first.

questions.question: What does a yellow and black diamond-shaped sign mean?

options.text: It warns you about road conditions ahead.
It helps direct you to cities and towns.
It tells you about traffic laws and rules.
It tells you about construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: It warns you about road conditions ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols or words on a yellow background. They warn you about conditions or hazards on or near the road ahead.

questions.question: If you stop along the road at night, you should:

options.text: Turn on your emergency flashers and leave your low beam headlights on.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn on your emergency flashers and leave your low beam headlights on.
questions.explanation: When stopped at night, turn on your emergency flashers and keep your low beam headlights on. This helps other drivers see your vehicle clearly.

questions.question: What does a flashing yellow light mean?

options.text: Stop and look, then go if no traffic is coming.
Stop and wait for a green light.
Speed up to clear the intersection quickly.
Slow down and proceed with caution.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means you should slow down and drive carefully through the intersection.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a divided highway is ahead. The road splits into two one-way roads with a median or divider between them. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: Can you drink alcohol in a vehicle on a public road?

options.text: Yes, as long as you are not driving.
Yes, if you sit in the back seat.
Yes, if you sit in the back of a pickup truck.

questions.explanation: The law prohibits drinking or carrying open alcohol in a vehicle on any public road. This applies to all passengers and all areas of the vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Road changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a hospital with emergency services is located to the right.

questions.question: A traffic light turns yellow as you approach an intersection. What should you do?

options.text: Speed up to pass through before it turns red.
Get ready to stop in the middle of the intersection.
Get ready to stop before the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Get ready to stop before the intersection.
questions.explanation: A yellow light means the red light is coming soon. Prepare to stop safely before you reach the intersection.

questions.question: Where are stop lines painted?
questions.explanation: Stop lines are white lines painted across traffic lanes at intersections and pedestrian crosswalks. They show exactly where you must stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a T intersection is ahead. Be ready to turn left or right.

questions.question: When are roads most slippery?

options.text: After rain has lasted one hour or longer.
During the first 10 to 15 minutes of rain.

questions.correctAnswerText: During the first 10 to 15 minutes of rain.
questions.explanation: Roads are most slippery in the first 10 to 15 minutes of rain. Rain brings oil from the asphalt to the surface. In hot weather, this is even worse.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: This sign warns of a winding road with three or more curves ahead.

questions.question: Two drivers arrive at an empty intersection at the same time. Who has the right-of-way?

options.text: One driver should honk to give up the right-of-way.

questions.explanation: When two vehicles arrive at an intersection at the same time, the driver on the right has the right-of-way. Let that driver go first, then proceed when safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that pedestrians cross here. Watch for people entering the crosswalk or crossing your path. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you that the road will curve ahead.

questions.question: What is the correct way to use a freeway exit ramp?

options.text: Slow down before entering the exit ramp.
Slow down once you enter the exit ramp.
Keep your speed the same on the exit ramp.
Pass slower traffic on the exit ramp.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down once you enter the exit ramp.
questions.explanation: Wait until you are on the exit ramp to slow down. Do not slow down before entering the ramp.

questions.question: For a first speeding conviction of 55 mph or more, 15 mph over the limit, your license will be suspended for how long?
questions.explanation: For a first conviction of speeding 55 mph or faster, 15 mph over the limit, your license will be suspended for at least 30 days. Penalties are worse for repeat violations.

questions.question: What happens when a bicyclist breaks traffic laws?

options.text: Bicyclists do not have to obey traffic laws.
They will always get a warning.
Their bicycle will be taken away.

questions.explanation: Bicyclists have the same rights and duties as drivers. Both bicyclists and drivers can be ticketed for breaking traffic laws.

questions.question: If you are in another driver's blind spot, what should you do?

options.text: Move ahead or fall back so the driver can see you.
Keep driving at the same speed.
Honk to let them know you are there.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move ahead or fall back so the driver can see you.
questions.explanation: Do not drive in someone's blind spot. Move ahead or drop back so the other driver can see you.

questions.question: You may be sent to a driver improvement clinic if you get how many points on your license?
questions.explanation: Points are added to your license for traffic violations. If you accumulate seven points, you may be ordered to attend a driver improvement clinic. The clinic fee is $65.

questions.question: If you come to water covering the road, what should you do?

options.text: Drive through until the water seems too deep.
Turn around and find another route.
Drive through; the water is unlikely to be deep.
Walk into the water to check how deep it is.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn around and find another route.
questions.explanation: Do not drive through flooded roads. You cannot tell how deep the water is or how strong the current is. Your car could be swept away or go underwater.

questions.question: What is your blind spot?

options.text: An area you cannot see without turning your head.
The area directly behind your vehicle.
The area you see in your rearview mirror.
The area you see in your side mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: An area you cannot see without turning your head.
questions.explanation: Your blind spots are areas you cannot see without moving your head. They are located to the sides and behind your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn about road conditions ahead. This sign warns you that the road may become slippery when wet.

questions.question: An oncoming car is to your left and a bicyclist is to your right. What should you do?

options.text: Let the car pass, then pass the bicycle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let the car pass, then pass the bicycle.
questions.explanation: When you face multiple hazards, handle them one at a time. Let the oncoming car pass first, then pass the bicyclist. Do not try to pass both at the same time.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers not to enter the road or driveway ahead from their current direction. If you see this sign, turn around and take a different route.

questions.question: You may pass another vehicle if the line between your lane and the lane you want to enter is a ____ line.
questions.explanation: White lines separate lanes going in the same direction. You can cross broken white lines to pass if the passing lane is clear.

questions.question: What do pennant-shaped signs mean?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs show no passing zones. The sign will also have words to confirm it is a no passing zone.

questions.question: Which statement about winter driving is NOT true?

options.text: Winter is the most difficult driving season.
Check your vehicle's antifreeze and windshield washer fluid levels in winter.
Using cruise control in winter weather is safe.
Snow tires are the best choice for your vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Using cruise control in winter weather is safe.
questions.explanation: Do not use cruise control on snow, rain, fog, or other hazardous conditions. Winter is the hardest driving season. Check antifreeze and windshield washer fluid often. Snow tires improve your vehicle's grip on slippery roads.

questions.question: ____ limit your concentration, perception, judgment, and memory.

options.text: Only a blood alcohol level greater than the legal limit can
Even the smallest amount of alcohol can
Only a blood alcohol level greater than 0.05 percent can

questions.correctAnswerText: Even the smallest amount of alcohol can
questions.explanation: Even a small amount of alcohol affects your focus, awareness, judgment, and memory. It makes your driving worse. Drinking and driving is never safe.

questions.question: What does a diamond-shaped sign mean?

options.text: Warns of existing or possible hazards.
Alerts drivers to public recreation areas.
Alerts drivers to upcoming food and gas locations.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns of existing or possible hazards.
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers about current or possible driving hazards. These signs are usually yellow or orange.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic light is ahead.
